scheme_name: Special Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme (SCLCSS) for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe
other_conditions: Must have a valid Udyam Registration.
Applicable to sole proprietorships, partnerships, co‑operatives, private or public limited companies owned by SC/ST entrepreneurs.
Enterprises must be in the manufacturing or service sectors.
SC/ST units must have graduated from small to medium scale within three years of graduation.
New industries graduating to medium scale due to the loan are eligible.
benefits_summary: Offers a 25% capital subsidy (up to ₹25 lakh) on institutional finance for purchase of plant and machinery/equipment to SC/ST micro and small enterprises.
